title: How to Set Up Black Friday & Cyber Monday on Your Shopify Store — No Apps Needed
description:
A real walkthrough on a Shopify dev store, using the Fuse theme — no extra apps installed.

What's covered:
• Setting a compare-at price so the theme shows a crossed-out price automatically
• Tagging products so the Black Friday badge appears on its own
• Styling the label colors in the theme customizer
• Adding a free shipping discount with a minimum order threshold
• Adding a discount code to the announcement bar, and seeing it apply live in the cart

Everything shown is the theme's own built-in tools — no third-party apps.

This is Fuse. Try it free, with no time limit — you pay only when you publish your store.
